summary: Day 58 of 72 (Phase 3 Milestone: Full 2-Hour Benchmark Mock 4): Sit for full 120-minute mock. Test full syllabus coverage (Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, P&C). Aim for 60+ net marks.

urgent_alerts.title: Passau Application Freeze & Submission Window
urgent_alerts.action: Submit completed Passau M.Sc. CS application before 15 Nov freeze to preserve 100% mental stamina for CAT exam.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Job Search Recruiter Triage & Screening Replies
blocks.details: 15–30 min recruiter communications triage: reply to inbound messages, confirm availability, schedule technical screenings, and follow up on pending submissions.

blocks.title: CAT Day 58: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: Benchmark Mock 4 - Section 3: QA 40 mins. Execute 3-round scan: Round 1 (easy 7 Qs), Round 2 (medium 5 Qs).. DILR: Benchmark Mock 4 - Section 2: DILR 40 mins. Perfect 2-set execution (8–10 questions without a single error)..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 58: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: Benchmark Mock 4 - Section 1: VARC 40 mins. Execute high-speed RC scanning. Target: 32+ marks. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
